This page showcases my key projects involving data visualisation and creative communication. A full collection of my designs can be viewed [here](/collection/designs.qmd).

### <a href="neigh.qmd" style="color: black; text-decoration: none;">Neighborhood Trajectories</a>

This [interactive dashboard](weijingg.github.io/Practicum/) brings to life a multi-scalar study of how neighborhood racial and ethnic compositions have evolved in 66 U.S. metropolitan areas from 1990 to 2020.

[![](/images/neigh/landing-page.jpg)](neigh.qmd){fig-alt="Neigh"}

<br>

### <a href="dams_story.html" style="color: black; text-decoration: none;">Dams in the Mekong</a>

This project conveys research findings regarding the dam network in the Mekong River Basin to the public through an engaging format with interactive elements. The visualisations are reproducible in **R**, with all codes available in this [github repository](https://github.com/weijingg/comms_HW2).

[![](/images/story.png)](dams_story.html){fig-alt="Story"}

<br>

### <a href="amazon_three.qmd" style="color: black; text-decoration: none;">Three Amazons</a>

This project explores the possibility of a vertical Amazon through a tactile crochet piece. While the Amazon is typically seen horizontally in plan, it can be reimagined vertically in section, as a three-layered system comprising the Voadores, the Amazon, and the Hamza. 

[![](/images/amazon_three/Slide1.png)](amazon_three.qmd){fig-alt="Three Amazons"}

<br>

### <a href="sg_water.qmd" style="color: black; text-decoration: none;">Singapore's water policy</a>

This project presents the historical milestones, management policies, and future challenges of Singapore's water resource system, and imagines Singapore's future plans to build a **"Long Island"** through a series of digital renders made using Photoshop. 

[![](/images/sg_water/sg_water.png)](sg_water.qmd){fig-alt="Singapore's water"}

<br>

### <a href="https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/25467ad902224761b111cd5f588f8d0e" style="color: black; text-decoration: none;">Skyrise greenery</a>

This storymap explores the types and distribution of skyrise greenery in Singapore, based on an independent fieldwork conducted along the southeast zone of the country.

[![](/images/skyrise.png)](https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/25467ad902224761b111cd5f588f8d0e){fig-alt="Skyrise greenery"}
